directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors
directionProbe.note: 藉 1·2 and 蕉 1·2 are the 艹 pair the dictionary writes bar-then-vertical; 藉 5 is the opening 丿 of 耒 drawn the other way round and 蕉 7 is the 隹 tick. Nothing is left over 60° afterwards and no row falls in the 45-60 band.

subThresholdSlants.method: direction-probe rows between 45° and 60° after the corrections
subThresholdSlants.note: No stroke in this batch falls in the sub-threshold band.

corpusAddition.note: Added in the special grade II batch 18 round: same AnimCJK revision and Arphic Public License as the Korean and Japanese files. 藉 and 蕉 qualify because the Taiwan standard draws 艹 in the four strokes the catalog counts.

sourceTransform.note: serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y); the offset does not change stroke directions.
